maddeler.e:
ينقسم (form VII)
# يَنْقَسِمُ (yanqasimu) /jan.qa.si.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْقَسَمَ (inqasama)
# يَنْقَسِمَ (yanqasima) /jan.qa.si.ma/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْقَسَمَ (inqasama)
# يَنْقَسِمْ (yanqasim) /jan.qa.sim/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْقَسَمَ (inqasama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
